When this card in Hand would be discarded by your "WBS"-named Spirit effect/exactly-named "Grandwalker Lakshmi"'s effect, instead of sending it to Trash, you can put it onto the Removed Zone.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can draw three cards. When you've done so, discard two cards from your Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit with the lowest cost.

BS53-059.name: The WBS Wrestler Mask-The-Mysterio
BS53-059.effect:
When this card in Hand is discarded or sent to the Removed Zone by your "WBS"-named Spirit effect/exactly-named "Grandwalker Lakshmi"'s effect, put a core from the Void to your Reserve. This effect can only be used once per turn.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to your Reserve.

BS53-060.name: The WBS Wrestler Syria
BS53-060.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can discard any number of cards from your Hand. When you've done so, for each card discarded, ignoring the cost of Braves, destroy an opposing Cost 6 or less Spirit.

[LV2] (When Attacks/Destroyed)
You can summon a "WBS"-named Spirit card from your Removed Zone by paying two costs.

BS53-041.name: The WanderingSteelKnight Deucalion
BS53-041.effect:
Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By discarding this card from the Removed Zone, refresh a "Steel"-named Spirit you control.

Flash - [Accel: Cost 5 ([White Core][White Core])]
Refresh a "Primal"/"Android" family Spirit you control. After this effect resolves, put this card face-up onto the Removed Zone.

BS53-TX04.name: The Yellow Dream Deity
BS53-TX04.effect:
[Brave Symbol +1]

[LV1] (When Reborn)
For each counter you have, during this turn, an opposing Spirit can't attack/block.

[LV1] [rtp]

[LV1] (Your Attack Step)
When your Reborn Spirit or Yellow "Primal" family Spirit attacks, during this turn, give an opposing Spirit -5000 BP, and you can destroy it if its BP reaches 0.

BS53-TX04-A13711.name: The Yellow World
BS53-TX04-A13711.effect:
[LV1] [Rebirth5]
When your Life is either reduced, or increased by your "Primal" family effect, or when this Nexus would leave the Field by opposing effects, you can flip this Nexus, putting your [Soul Core] onto it.

[LV1] (When Deployed)
During this turn, give an opposing Spirit -6000 BP, and destroy it if its BP is brought to 0.

[LV1] (Opposing Attack Step)
Opposing originally Cost 6 or less Spirits can't be refreshed by effects.

BS53-X04.name: The ZeroRideEmpress Queen-Flawless
BS53-X04.effect:
This card/Spirit on your Field/Trash/Removed Zone can't be returned to the Hand/Deck and can't be switched in places by either player's effects.

This card in Hand is unaffected by opposing effects, and when you have three or more White-only "Primal" family cards in your Trash, you can summon it without paying the cost during the Flash Timing of the opposing Attack Step. When you've done so, during this turn, this Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
This Spirit gains +5000 BP, and once per turn, it can refresh.

BS53-CP04.name: Vicerave - The King
BS53-CP04.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
Opposing Spirits must block if possible.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed via BP comparison, send an opposing Life to the Trash, and return all opposing Nexuses to the deckbottom.
